Container images in the Dockerfiles, compose files and workflows: patch and digest updates together, so one image stays on one version everywhere; minor and major updates get a pull request of their own because image tags do not follow strict semver
packageRules.groupName: Container image patch and digest updates

packageRules.description: The uv image in backend/Dockerfile and the uv version in ci.yml and fuzz.yml must be the same, so they are always bumped together

Safe small updates merge by themselves once the required checks pass (what dependabot-auto-merge.yml did): patch and minor package and action updates. Container images (Dockerfiles, compose files, workflow images), digests and majors always wait for the maintainer.
The uv group mixes an image and a tool version: never automatic, and no release-age wait, so the image and the version in the workflows are proposed together.
